title: Install spaCR with Conda
description: Create a Conda environment, install spaCR from conda-forge and launch the application.
objectives: Create and activate a dedicated Conda environment.
Open spaCR and update the same environment when needed.
prerequisite: Install Conda or Miniforge, then open a terminal where the conda command is available.

scenes.narration: Open a Conda-enabled terminal. You will create an environment for spaCR, install the conda-forge package and launch the application from that environment.

Create an environment named spacr-conda with Python three point twelve and spaCR from conda-forge, using the displayed command. Choose another name if you already use that name for a different environment.
Conda solves the environment and lists its package plan. Review it, type y to accept, then wait for the download and installation to finish.
Activate spacr-conda. Run the displayed Python command to see the environment path, and check that it is the environment you just created.

Run conda list spacr to see the installed version and confirm that it comes from conda-forge. Installing Python and spaCR in one command lets Conda resolve every package together, which is much faster than adding spaCR to an existing environment.
Check the installed spaCR version and package location. Keep that version with your analysis notes so you can return to the same environment later.

Run spacr-doctor to check the installation. Here it reports that vispy, a core dependency, is missing, and shows the command that installs it. Run that command, then run spacr-doctor again. Follow other suggested steps only for the file formats or features you need.
Enter spacr to launch the application. Complete any first-launch choices, then continue with the Home tutorial to find modules and their example data.

To update later, close spaCR, activate this environment and update the conda-forge package. When conda-forge has no newer build, Conda reports that all requested packages are already installed. Check the installed version afterwards; the pip and installer lessons cover the other installation routes.
